summary_en: The paper presents a high-frequency spherical-array system that combines real-time three-dimensional tomographic optoacoustic imaging with focused-ultrasound therapy. Experiments in mouse brain ex vivo and a living sheep show image-guided targeting and optoacoustic monitoring of thermal lesion formation, with MRI and histology used for validation.

summary_en: This work develops dual-wavelength ultra-wideband raster-scan optoacoustic mesoscopy using 515 nm and 532 nm excitation for three-dimensional mapping of skin microvascular oxygenation. Human post-occlusive reactive hyperemia experiments capture ischemic decline, hyperemic overshoot, and recovery at single-microvessel-scale resolution.
